title: Oakvale's farmland
changes: A windmill now stands on the North Meadow above Millbrook, its sails turning in the wind. You can't walk through it.
Oakvale's farms look like farms: stooks of sheaves and a scarecrow at Goldenreach, beehives, sack carts at the mill and on the square, and hide frames at the Hunter's Camp.
Odo the miller and Huntmaster Bryn have new things to say about the valley's grain, and Oakvale's smith and armourer greet you with farm talk.
